files.s: In this file we prove that the series `∑' k in ℕ, 1 / k ^ p` converges if and only if `p > 1`. The proof is based on the Cauchy condensation test: `∑ k, f k` converges if and only if so does `∑ k, 2 ^ k f (2 ^ k)`. We prove this test in `NNReal.summable_condensed_iff` and `summable_condensed_iff_of_nonneg`, then use it to prove `summable_one_div_rpow`.

h.d: The harmonic series restricted to a residue class is not summable.
Harmonic series is not unconditionally summable.

Test for convergence of the `p`-series: the real-valued series `∑' n : ℕ, 1 / n ^ p` converges if and only if `1 < p`.

files.t: Calculus results on exponential in a Banach algebra
files.s: In this file, we prove basic properties about the derivative of the exponential map `exp` in a Banach algebra `𝔸` over a field `𝕂`. We keep them separate from the main file `Analysis.Normed.Algebra.Exponential` in order to minimize dependencies.

h.d: If `f` has sum `a`, then `NormedSpace.exp ∘ f` has product `NormedSpace.exp a`.
The exponential map in `𝕂 = ℝ` or `𝕂 = ℂ` has derivative `1` at zero.
The exponential map in `𝕂 = ℝ` or `𝕂 = ℂ` has strict derivative `1` at zero.
The exponential map in `𝕂 = ℝ` or `𝕂 = ℂ` has derivative `NormedSpace.exp x` at any point `x`.
The exponential map in `𝕂 = ℝ` or `𝕂 = ℂ` has strict derivative `NormedSpace.exp x` at any point `x`.
The exponential map in a commutative Banach algebra `𝔸` over `𝕂 = ℝ` or `𝕂 = ℂ` has Fréchet derivative `NormedSpace.exp x • 1 : 𝔸 →L[𝕂] 𝔸` at any point `x`.

files.t: Critical values of the Riemann zeta function
files.s: In this file we prove formulae for the critical values of `ζ(s)`, and more generally of Hurwitz zeta functions, in terms of Bernoulli polynomials.

h.d: Explicit formula for `L(χ, 3)`, where `χ` is the unique nontrivial Dirichlet character modulo 4.
Recurrence relation (in `k`) for the `n`-th Fourier coefficient of `Bₖ`.
